001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.Collection;
006import java.util.Collections;
007import java.util.Comparator;
008import java.util.Iterator;
009import java.util.List;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
013import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
014import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
017
018/**
019 * Provides methods for comparing nodes according to the
020 * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">Metapath
021 * specification</a>.
022 */
023public final class NodeComparators {
024  private static final Comparator<IFlagNodeItem> FLAG_SORT
025      = Comparator.comparing(IFlagNodeItem::getQName, IEnhancedQName::compareTo);
026
027  /**
028   * Compare two node items for equality.
029   *
030   * @param item1
031   *          the first item to compare
032   * @param item2
033   *          the second item to compare
034   * @param dynamicContext
035   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
036   *          timezone
037   * @return {@code true} if both node items are the same type and have the same
038   *         flag and model members, or {@code false} otherwise
039   */
040  public static boolean compareNodeItem(
041      @NonNull INodeItem item1,
042      @NonNull INodeItem item2,
043      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
044    return item1.getNodeType() == item2.getNodeType()
045        && compareFlags(item1.getFlags(), item2.getFlags(), dynamicContext)
046        && compareModelItems(item1.getModelItems(), item2.getModelItems(), dynamicContext);
047  }
048
049  private static boolean compareAtomics(
050      @Nullable IAnyAtomicItem atomic1,
051      @Nullable IAnyAtomicItem atomic2,
052      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
053    return (atomic1 == null && atomic2 == null) || (atomic1 != null && atomic1.deepEquals(atomic2, dynamicContext));
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Compare two node items for equality.
058   *
059   * @param item1
060   *          the first item to compare
061   * @param item2
062   *          the second item to compare
063   * @param dynamicContext
064   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
065   *          timezone
066   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if the first argument
067   *         is less than, equal to, or greater than the second.
068   */
069  public static boolean compareModelNodeItem(
070      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1,
071      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2,
072      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
073    boolean retval;
074    if (item1 instanceof IAssemblyNodeItem) {
075      retval = compareNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext);
076    } else if (item1 instanceof IFieldNodeItem) {
077      retval = compareAsField(item1, item2, dynamicContext);
078    } else {
079      throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Unsupported model node item type: " + item1.getClass().getName());
080    }
081    return retval;
082  }
083
084  private static boolean compareFlags(
085      @NonNull Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem> flags1,
086      @NonNull Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem> flags2,
087      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
088    Comparator<Collection<? extends IFlagNodeItem>> bySize = Comparator.comparingInt(Collection::size);
089    int delta = bySize.compare(flags1, flags2);
090    if (delta != 0) {
091      return false;
092    }
093
094    // sort the collections to compare in an order independent way
095    List<IFlagNodeItem> list1 = new ArrayList<>(flags1);
096    List<IFlagNodeItem> list2 = new ArrayList<>(flags2);
097    Collections.sort(list1, FLAG_SORT);
098    Collections.sort(list2, FLAG_SORT);
099
100    // compare the results
101    for (int i = 0; i < list1.size(); i++) {
102      if (!compareAsFlag(
103          ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(list1.get(i)),
104          ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(list2.get(i)),
105          dynamicContext)) {
106        return false;
107      }
108    }
109    return true;
110  }
111
112  private static boolean compareModelItems(
113      @NonNull Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> items1,
114      @NonNull Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> items2,
115      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
116    Comparator<Collection<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>>> bySize
117        = Comparator.comparingInt(Collection::size);
118    int delta = bySize.compare(items1, items2);
119    if (delta != 0) {
120      return false;
121    }
122
123    Iterator<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> thisIterator = items1.iterator();
124    Iterator<? extends List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>>> otherIterator = items2.iterator();
125    while (thisIterator.hasNext() && otherIterator.hasNext()) {
126      List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> l1 = thisIterator.next();
127      List<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> l2 = otherIterator.next();
128
129      Iterator<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> il1 = l1.iterator();
130      Iterator<? extends IModelNodeItem<?, ?>> il2 = l2.iterator();
131      while (thisIterator.hasNext() && otherIterator.hasNext()) {
132        IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1 = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(il1.next());
133        IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2 = ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(il2.next());
134
135        if (!compareModelNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext)) {
136          return false;
137        }
138      }
139    }
140    return true;
141  }
142
143  /**
144   * Compare two flag node items for equality.
145   *
146   * @param item1
147   *          the first item to compare
148   * @param item2
149   *          the second item to compare
150   * @param dynamicContext
151   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
152   *          timezone
153   * @return {@code true} if both flags have the same name and value, or
154   *         {@code false} otherwise
155   */
156  public static boolean compareAsFlag(
157      @NonNull IFlagNodeItem item1,
158      @NonNull IFlagNodeItem item2,
159      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
160    return item1.getQName().equals(item2.getQName())
161        && compareAtomics(item1.toAtomicItem(), item2.toAtomicItem(), dynamicContext);
162  }
163
164  private static boolean compareAsField(
165      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item1,
166      @NonNull IModelNodeItem<?, ?> item2,
167      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
168    return compareNodeItem(item1, item2, dynamicContext)
169        && compareAtomics(item1.toAtomicItem(), item2.toAtomicItem(), dynamicContext);
170  }
171
172  private NodeComparators() {
173    // disable construction
174  }
175}
